pagi.title: 5 Mind-Blowing Facts About the Human Brain
pagi.topic: fascinating neuroscience facts: the brain generates enough electricity to power a light bulb, neurons fire 200 times per second, the brain is 73% water, and memory is not stored in one place

pagi.title: Crazy Facts About Space That Will Shock You
pagi.topic: unbelievable space facts: a day on Venus is longer than its year, neutron stars spin 700 times per second, there are more stars than grains of sand on Earth, space smells like seared steak

pagi.title: 5 Facts About Animals That Seem Impossible
pagi.topic: shocking animal facts: octopuses have 3 hearts and blue blood, mantis shrimp can punch with the force of a bullet, tardigrades can survive in outer space, crows remember human faces

pagi.title: Unbelievable Facts About the Deep Ocean
pagi.topic: deep sea mysteries: 95% of the ocean is unexplored, creatures in the Mariana Trench survive crushing pressure, bioluminescent organisms create their own light, the ocean floor has mountains taller than Everest

pagi.title: 5 Facts About Time That Will Bend Your Mind
pagi.topic: mind-bending time facts: time moves slower near massive objects, the past present and future exist simultaneously according to physics, clocks on GPS satellites run faster than on Earth, Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the pyramids

pagi.title: Wild Facts About the Human Body You Never Knew
pagi.topic: bizarre human body facts: your stomach gets a new lining every 3-4 days, bones are 4 times stronger than concrete, the human eye can detect a candle flame 14 miles away, you produce enough saliva in a lifetime to fill two swimming pools

pagi.title: 5 Historical Facts That Sound Fake But Are True
pagi.topic: shocking history facts: ancient Romans used crushed mouse brains as toothpaste, Napoleon was once attacked by rabbits, Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire, forks were once considered sacrilegious in Europe

siang.title: 5 Facts About Quantum Physics That Break Reality
siang.topic: quantum mechanics facts that defy common sense: particles can be in two places at once, observing a particle changes its behavior, quantum entanglement allows instant communication across any distance, Schrodinger's cat thought experiment explained

siang.title: Incredible Facts About the Universe's Size
siang.topic: universe scale facts: the observable universe is 93 billion light-years across, there are more galaxies than grains of sand on all Earth's beaches, light from the Sun takes 8 minutes to reach Earth, the Milky Way would take 100,000 years to cross at light speed

siang.title: 5 Facts About DNA That Will Blow Your Mind
siang.topic: DNA facts: if you uncoiled all the DNA in your body it would stretch to Pluto and back 17 times, humans share 60% DNA with bananas, DNA can store all internet data in a teaspoon, DNA degrades after 6.8 million years

siang.title: Shocking Facts About Artificial Intelligence
siang.topic: AI facts that seem like science fiction: AI can detect cancer more accurately than doctors, an AI wrote a novel that almost won a literary prize, AI can predict earthquakes and solar flares, machines can now dream and hallucinate just like humans

siang.title: 5 Facts About Black Holes That Defy Logic
siang.topic: black hole facts: time stops at the event horizon, a black hole the size of a coin would have the mass of Earth, black holes are not actually holes they are incredibly dense objects, Stephen Hawking proved black holes can slowly evaporate

siang.title: Mind-Blowing Facts About Mathematics
siang.topic: math facts that seem impossible: there are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe, infinity comes in different sizes, 0.999 repeating equals exactly 1, the number googol has more digits than atoms in the universe

siang.title: 5 Facts About Volcanoes That Will Surprise You
siang.topic: volcano facts: there are over 1,500 potentially active volcanoes on Earth, underwater volcanoes create new islands, volcanic lightning occurs in eruption clouds, the largest volcano in the solar system is on Mars and is 3 times taller than Everest

malam.title: 5 Creepy Facts About the Human Body at Night
malam.topic: what happens to your body while you sleep: your brain removes toxins, you grow slightly taller, your body temperature drops, you can have up to 7 dreams per night, sleep paralysis is your brain keeping you from acting out dreams

malam.title: Unbelievable Facts About Dreams and the Brain
malam.topic: dream science facts: blind people dream with other senses, you cannot dream of a face you have never seen, some people dream in black and white, lucid dreaming can be trained, dreams can solve complex problems and inspire great inventions

malam.title: 5 Facts About Stars That Sound Like Fantasy
malam.topic: star facts: the sun is so large that 1.3 million Earths could fit inside, some stars are older than the universe appears to allow, magnetars have magnetic fields so strong they could erase credit cards from halfway to the Moon, stars can orbit each other

malam.title: Shocking Facts About Ancient Civilizations
malam.topic: ancient world facts: ancient Egyptians slept on stone pillows, the Roman Empire had a welfare system, ancient Greeks believed the brain was for cooling the blood, the Antikythera mechanism is a 2000-year-old analog computer

malam.title: 5 Facts About Light That Will Change How You See
malam.topic: light and optics facts: light slows down when passing through glass, a photon takes 100,000 years to travel from the Sun's core to its surface but only 8 minutes to reach Earth, you can see 2.5 million light-years with the naked eye, darkness travels faster than light

malam.title: Mind-Bending Facts About Parallel Universes
malam.topic: multiverse theory facts: the many-worlds interpretation suggests every quantum event creates a new universe, there may be infinite copies of you making different choices, string theory requires 11 dimensions, cosmic inflation suggests our universe is one of countless bubbles

malam.title: 5 Facts About Viruses That Are Truly Terrifying
malam.topic: virus facts: viruses are not technically alive yet they are the most abundant entity on Earth, there are viruses that infect other viruses, 8% of human DNA comes from ancient viruses, bacteriophage viruses kill more bacteria per day than all antibiotics combined
